items.text: Hello!
Just as we promised, we have a small update for you! :) The full release notes are below.

We are now focusing on our next project—a smaller game in a slightly different genre that we'll announce soon. We are planning to release this one quite fast! :) It will expand The End of the Sun universe from a different perspective :) Interested?
Please note that we might still bring new content updates to The End of the Sun in the future, depending on the game's ongoing popularity! (We are currently considering a "Historical Update")

notes.title: The End of the Sun - Update 2.0.2

items.text: Visual Updates: Updated the game logo, loading screen icon, and the main application icon to their newer versions.

Collision & Stuck Spot Fixes: Fixed several areas in the game world where players could get stuck. We've also implemented additional fail-safes to prevent the character from getting blocked in the future.
Photo Mode UI Fix: Resolved an issue where the Photo Mode user interface (UI) would occasionally remain visible on the final screenshots.

Credits Update: Updated the end credits to correct outdated information. Studio Name Update: Updated the studio name in-game to reflect our recent rebranding: The End of the Sun Forge (formerly "The End of the Sun Team").
UI Resolution Fixes: Fixed user interface scaling issues where certain indicators and text (especially in Photo Mode) were cut off on specific screen resolutions.
Mouse Cursor Hotspot Fix: Adjusted the mouse cursor's hotspot, making menu navigation much smoother and more precise.
We would also like to remind you that this is the best time to buy the game, as it is part of the Summer Sale right now! :)

items.text: Hey everyone,
This is a huge honor for us, and we're celebrating by offering a fantastic, our biggest so far!
If you've been waiting to dive into the game's fantasy open world, now's the perfect chance!
But that's not all – we have one more surprise for you!
To mark this special occasion, we've just released the highly anticipated Photo Mode in the game!
We know many of you have been asking for this, and we're thrilled to finally bring it to you.

Now you can immerse yourself even deeper in the world of The End of the Sun and capture your favorite moments and breathtaking shots like never before. Get ready to unleash your inner in-game photographer!
Check out the new Photo Mode Trailer!
Photo mode takes screenshots automatically to your Steam library.
To celebrate the launch of Photo Mode, we're kicking off our very first screenshot contest! Here's how to participate:
Take a stunning screenshot using the new Photo Mode in The End of the Sun Game.
Share it on Steam Community Hub (make sure it's public!).
Get as many likes as possible! IMPORTANT! A minimum of 50 likes is required to participate in the competition! (Finally, only likes on Steam count)
(To get more likes, share your screenshot on your social media channels, encourage your friends to like your screenshot, and be sure to tag our official game profile when you post.)
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/EndOfTheSunGame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/endofsungame/
X/Twitter: https://x.com/endofthesungame
Tik Tok: https://www.tiktok.com/@endofsungame
How to share screenshots? Check out!
Choose a screenshot from your Steam Library on The End of the Sun page
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/b2163cf3765fe91cea5b97aeec79ab2447c30bb8.jpg"]
Press the right mouse button and click "Share," and after "Share on Steam"
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/96f37571a5920bbd83c46944a2e47fb117ded5fe.jpg"]
Don't forget to share it publicly! (Visibility section)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/db9fbafecadd1d50e8dd4f5db2c5cf7fec0e608b.jpg"]
Ready!
What's in it for you? Awesome prizes, of course!
1st Place: A physical Collector's Boxed Edition of the game!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/f565b604a36cc93a5ef6105c3ee5293ea8e7aa9a.jpg"]
2nd Place: Copy of the game for a friend! (Steam key)
3rd Place: The official The End of the Sun Soundtrack! (Steam key)
Special Publisher Choice Award: The End of the Sun - Soundtrack Edition (Include game + Soundtrack) (Steam key)
(An additional prize for the most artistic screenshot! )

The contest runs throughout the promotional period, July 20th to August 1st. Winners will be selected on August 3rd. The winners and their screenshots will be announced in a separate update. Stay tuned!
We can't wait to see your incredible creations!
